purpose: Check task framing and avoid claiming established techniques as novelty, not prescribe an architecture
search_type: Targeted primary-source scoping, not a systematic literature review

sources.title: A Dataset for Hyper-Relational Extraction and a Cube-Filling Approach
sources.relevance: Relations plus qualifiers have already been studied; simply adding condition fields or saying joint extraction is not sufficient novelty.
sources.limit: Generic HyperRED does not establish pump procedure, obligation or table-binding performance.

sources.title: Document-Level Event Argument Extraction by Conditional Generation
sources.relevance: Document-level argument extraction and coreference are established candidate categories for cross-sentence binding.
sources.limit: Its benchmark performance is not evidence that the local pump task is solved or that a specific generator should be selected.

sources.title: Deep Entity Matching with Pre-Trained Language Models
sources.relevance: Contextual pair matching is a candidate category for difficult identity/duplicate cases.
sources.limit: Local five alias groups do not support training a new matching architecture; context-equivalent assertions differ from same labels.

sources.title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
sources.relevance: Evidence attribution and revision are candidate ways to ground enrichment.
sources.limit: Retrieving attribution is not sufficient for correctly binding equipment, guards, operands or procedure branches; AI review is not human truth.

sources.title: AutoSchemaKG: Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction through Dynamic Schema Induction from Web-Scale Corpora
sources.relevance: Dynamic schema induction and entity/event construction are possible categories when fixed relations cannot express source processes.
sources.limit: Its web-scale claims do not justify replacing this project's frozen schema or selecting schema induction as the final method.

candidate_categories_not_selected: deterministic constraint grammar and stronger generic parsing
document-level event argument and reference resolution
qualified/n-ary assertion representation and versioned schema adaptation
graph_representation_and_rule_learning_p: May be compared later if the selected task actually needs relational context; no path, GNN, KGE or rule-learning architecture is mandatory now.
conclusion: Literature reinforces the need to isolate source-specific binding failures and compare stronger generic methods; it does not establish a new algorithmic contribution.
